svg.text: LIVING PORTRAITS/ Architecture v4 (two-machine: panels move to hil08rd; SC2 stays the GPU bakery)

Self-aware theatrical portraits on two LED panels. v4 splits the system across two tailnet hosts: the SHOW (player + director + rig + cross-frame walk) relocates to hil08rd, the machine wired to the panels; the GPU BAKERY (SD1.5 gen + verify gate) stays on supercommons2. Assets sync SC2 → hil; the director either runs Ollama locally (if hil has a GPU) or reaches SC2's qwen3 over the tailnet. Still no realtime: pre-baked beats, deterministic player.

Legend: green = built & running · cyan = built + verified, migrating · amber = migration step (this runbook) · violet = contract / seam · red = pending on-site (real panels). Migration state: built+verified on SC2 → moving the show to hil08rd. Tooling: deploy_host.ps1 · sync_assets.ps1 · bringup_host.ps1 · panels.yaml. Runbook: MIGRATION.md.
MACHINE A · hil08rd (desktop-hil08rd · 100.71.118.128) — THE PANEL MACHINE: the show lives here, drives the two LED panels
1 · INPUTS / SIGNALS (director/signals.py + director/feeds.py) · runs on hil
THE SIGNAL + Calendar + weather · 30-min TTL · offline-degrade to stub
2 · DIRECTOR / BRAIN (director/stage_manager.py) · qwen3:8b · format=json · /no_think · --loop 45s · process runs on hil
schema: scene / A / B / bridge / move
hil has NO GPU: LP_OLLAMA → SC2 over tailnet
conductor edits stage_manager.py:24 to read LP_OLLAMA env
3 · CONTROL CHANNEL · the only seam between brain and stage · local file on hil
4 · PLAYER / STAGE (player.py + runtime/) · pygame, borderless window @ (0,0), top-most + windowless, console session 1 · runs on hil
5 · OUTPUT / EDGE · hil's desktop framebuffer -> LED sending card -> panels · the physical edge moves to hil
panels.yaml sized to hil's monitor + LED card
grabs the region, maps each sub-rect to a panel
confirm A=(0,0) B=(256,0) on hil's card on-site
6 · CLIP LIBRARY (consumed on hil) · the baked footage the player reads · synced FROM SC2, then read locally
all-on-hil variant bakes here too; two-machine variant receives via sync_assets.ps1
feeds the player loop · reads stage_state.json
install_tasks.ps1 (or deploy_host.ps1): lp-player + lp-director AT-LOGON interactive · lp-watchdog every 5 min · reboot-survivable
if hil08rd has its OWN NVIDIA GPU, the whole system is self-contained at the panels — SC2 drops out entirely
bringup_host.ps1 detects the GPU and takes the PRODUCER path on hil: builds .venv-gen (torch cu121 + diffusers + SD1.5 + piper + insightface + SAM deps),
pulls qwen3:8b + qwen2.5vl:7b LOCALLY, and bakes portraits on hil. Then: no asset sync, no LP_OLLAMA, no tailnet hop.
SKIPPED in this variant: sync_assets.ps1 (zone 6 bakes in place) · LP_OLLAMA (Ollama is on 127.0.0.1) · the SC2 ↔ hil tailnet link.
Trade-off: hil needs the heavy generative stack + a capable GPU. The two-machine split exists precisely for when hil has NO GPU —
the show is light + deterministic (runs anywhere), the bake is heavy + GPU-bound (stays on SC2's 2080 Ti). Same code, two topologies.
GPU BACKEND · bakes assets; optionally serves qwen3 to hil
+ SAM / InsightFace / Piper installed by sc2_bringup.ps1
orchestrate.py: gen -> segment -> rig -> verify -> clip row
strict mode: registers only CLEAN passes
output = the clip library that syncs to hil

text.tspan: pygame · opencv · numpy (runtime, also needed on hil)

svg.text: all-on-hil variant needs .venv-gen on hil too
The 2080 Ti is here. Baking (SD1.5 + img2vid + verify) is
slow + GPU-bound; the show is deterministic + light. Split
so a panel host with no GPU still runs the show, and the
heavy gen never competes with the player for the desktop.
portraits + cutouts + rigs + clips : SC2 -> hil
hil's director -> SC2's Ollama, only if hil has no GPU
If hil HAS a GPU: skip the qwen3 call (Ollama runs locally),
and the all-on-hil variant bakes on hil too — SC2 then
drops out entirely and the show is fully self-contained.

PRINCIPLES no-realtime · deterministic-player · async-generative-backfill · fourth-wall-always-on · verify-before-the-library · show-light-bakery-heavy · one-host-can-be-both (all-on-hil) · tailnet-is-the-only-cross-machine-seam

MIGRATION STATE built+verified on SC2 (player + qwen3 director + first portrait + 6 modules) → moving the SHOW to hil08rd. Tooling built in parallel: bringup_host.ps1 (GPU-detect) · deploy_host.ps1 · sync_assets.ps1 + LP_OLLAMA · panels.yaml/runtime/panels.py (display fit).

RUNBOOK ORDER (a) enable SSH on hil · (b) bringup_host.ps1 GPU-detect · (c) deploy_host.ps1 · (d) sync_assets.ps1 + LP_OLLAMA if no GPU · (e) panels.yaml fit · (f) start + verify on real panels · (g) confirm LED-card mapping. projects/living-portraits/living-portraits-architecture-v4.svg + MIGRATION.md · 2026-05-26 · supersedes v3
